items.t: 엔비디아, AI 노트북 플랫폼 ‘RTX 스파크’ 출시… 그레이스 CPU·블랙웰 GPU 결합
items.d: 엔비디아가 중앙처리장치(CPU)와 그래픽처리장치(GPU)를 하나로 결합해 고성능 인공지능(AI) 모델을 노트북에서 직접 실행할 수 있는 새로운 컴퓨팅 플랫폼 ‘RTX 스파크’를 출시했다. 최대 128기가바이트(GB)의 통합 메모리와 1페타플롭(PFLOPS)의 AI 연산 성능을 제공해 클라우드 서버에 의존하지 않고도 AI 모델과 에이전트를 구동할 수 있는 것

items.t: 하만 레디 어웨어, ‘올해의 운전자 안전솔루션’ 수상
items.d: 하만 레디 어웨어가 ‘2026 오토테크 브레이크스루 어워즈’에서 올해의 운전자 안전 솔루션으로 선정됐다.레디 어웨어는 차량과 도로·교통·기상·인프라 데이터를 결합해 운전자에게 실시간에 가까운 위험 정보를 제공하는 클라우드 기반 솔루션이다. 교통 신호 변경, 전방 차량 급제동, 미끄러운 도로, 차선 폐쇄 등 15개 이상 커넥티드 안전 기능을 지원한다.특히 차량에 별도 센서나 통신 하드웨어를 추가하지 않고 기존 차량의 통신 장비와 클라우드 인프라를 활용할 수 있도록 설계됐다. 인프라와 차량 데이터를 분석해 운전자에게 필요한 알림을 제공하고, 불필요한 경고를 줄여 주행 중 상황 인식을 돕는다.자동차 제조사는 기존 4G·5G 인프라를 활용해 관련 기능을 도입할 수 있다. 소프트웨어 업데이트를 통해 안전 기능을 지속

items.fullText: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW Plus, stream ‘Enshrouded’ 1.0 and ‘Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2’ alongside 10 new games this week. October 15, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Dial in the next gaming session this GFN Thursday. New NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls give GeForce NOW members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. Then, step into the Shroud as Keen Games’ Enshrouded leaves early access with its 1.0 release, or let the bolts fly in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 . Both are streaming on GeForce NOW at launch. With 10 new games joining the cloud this week, members can put the new controls to work in supported titles and keep playing across supported devices without downloads, installs or expensive hardware upgrades. Fine-Tune the Cloud With DLSS 4.5 Controls More control, more cloud power. NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls are now available on GeForce NOW, giving members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. DLSS Super Resolution sharpens image quality, while Dynamic Multi Frame Generation delivers lower latency and reduces stutter for smoother streaming, and Ray Reconstruction enhances ray-traced visuals. In addition, Ultimate members streaming on GeForce RTX 5080-powered cloud rigs benefit from the maximum available options, including Dynamic Multi Frame Generation up to 4X. From James Bond’s globe-trotting missions in 007 First Light — now with path tracing support — to CONTROL Resonant ’s reality-bending Manhattan and the shadowy scares of Resident Evil Requiem , the controls help fine-tune supported games for image quality, responsiveness or a preferred balance between the two. These new settings are available in the GeForce NOW app under settings, for Windows, macOS, Chrome OS and Steam OS platforms. Members can read here for more details

items.fullText: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW Plus, discover 10 new games streaming from the cloud this week. October 8, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Gears of War: E-Day leads the charge on GeForce NOW this week, bringing Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago’s first fight against the Locust Horde to the cloud with GeForce RTX-powered performance. A new way to join the action is also coming: Fire TV users will soon be able to purchase GeForce NOW memberships directly through Amazon , creating a more seamless path from device setup to gameplay. Keep an eye out for availability in the coming weeks. There’s more in store this GFN Thursday, with the cloud serving up 10 games, including seven new releases. Emergence Day Is Here Gears of War: E-Day is now streaming on GeForce NOW following its global release on Tuesday, Oct. 6. Set 14 years before the original Gears of War , the prequel follows Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago as they confront the terrifying arrival of the Locust Horde on Emergence Day. The series’ brutal combat, desperate survival and larger-than-life action return with a new origin story for the legendary partnership. Ultimate members can take on the Horde with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud, plus technologies including NVIDIA DLSS and NVIDIA Reflex . From campaign missions to cooperative and competitive modes, GeForce NOW keeps the fight ready across low-power laptops, Macs, mobile devices, handhelds, Firefox and other browsers, and more — no massive downloads or expensive gaming rig required. New on the Cloud Menu Members can look forward to the following games joining the GeForce NOW library this week: Gears of War: E-Day (New release on Steam and Xbox , Oct. 6), available on Game Pass STAR WARS: Galactic Racer (New release on Steam , Oct. 6) Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival (New release on Steam , Oct. 8) Forever Ago (New release on Steam , Oct. 8) Orde

items.fullText: Fall Into 25 New Games on GeForce NOW This October Claim a ‘CONTROL Resonant’ reward and stream ‘The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered’ alongside six games this week. October 1, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Spooky season is streaming in. Alongside falling leaves, pumpkin spice and everything nice, 25 new games are joining GeForce NOW throughout October, including six ready to play this week. From a new CONTROL Resonant reward for Performance and Ultimate members to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered joining the cloud, this GFN Thursday is packed with fresh reasons to play. Claim Rewards A new reward from a world gone sideways. CONTROL Resonant is streaming from the cloud for GeForce NOW Performance and Ultimate members. Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation as Dylan Faden harnesses extraordinary powers to battle the Hiss, the Mold and other reality-bending threats while searching for his sister, Federal Bureau of CONTROL Director Jesse Faden. Performance and Ultimate members can claim the Third Ice Baseball Cap reward for CONTROL Resonant . After claiming the reward code, launch the Steam or Epic Games Store version of CONTROL Resonant , select “Options” from the main menu, navigate to “Gameplay” and choose “Enter Redeem Code.” The reward can be equipped after completing Act 1. Cap it off: Claim the reward from Thursday, Oct. 1, through Sunday, Nov. 1, at 11:59 p.m. PT, before it slips into another dimension. The White Wolf Rides Again The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered launched Tuesday, Sept. 29, and is now streaming for Performance and Ultimate members. Follow the iconic tale of Geralt of Rivia, a monster slayer for hire, as he tracks down the Child of Prophecy in a war-torn, monster-infested open world. The remastered adventure brings Geralt’s beloved world back at refreshed specs across nearly any device. GeForce NOW handles the rendering, download
